items.q: How much does editing cost per video?
items.a: Full editing for a long-form YouTube release starts at $200. Final investment depends on raw footage volume, graphics density, and pacing. An exact quote is provided within 1–2 hours after reviewing raw material and your brief.

items.q: What are your exact turnaround times?
items.a: The first structured draft cut is delivered within 48–72 hours after receiving raw footage. The final release with motion graphics, color grading, and mastered audio is delivered in 3–5 business days.

items.q: How do we transfer raw video files?
items.a: Via Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, or Telegram. For large camera cards, direct high-speed links ensure rapid transfer without compression.

items.q: How many revision rounds are included?
items.a: Every project includes 2 comprehensive timecode-based revision passes. This is consistently sufficient because core pacing is locked in the initial draft.

items.q: How do we handle feedback and notes?
items.a: You review the private preview link and send timecode notes in Telegram or a shared document. Notes are implemented within 24 hours.

items.q: Do you work with international clients?
items.a: Yes, I work with creators and brands worldwide (US, Europe, Central Asia). Payments are handled via USDT, cryptocurrency, or wire transfer.
